pages.text: Young rice plants filled a bamboo basket. The top leaves were bright green.
Dingding gently lifted them. Leaves below drooped. "I will choose only strong ones."
Mom glanced at the top. "All fresh. Just plant them."
She put the basket on the bank and went to another job.
Dingding planted a row as she said. Drooping leaves lay weakly on the water.
Dingding looked closely. Still drooping. None stood up.
"Mom, look." "Oh? They were fine before." Mom looked only at the basket top again.
Dingding tipped out the whole basket, separating drooping plants from upright ones.
Only upright ones went into rows. Every leaf stood straight.
Drooping rice plants piled on the bank. Mom shook the empty basket. "So many down below?"
